_doc: The Spell Board's cartridges (PLAN M6). Every spell is a FIRE MISSION with physics: it uses the world's own rules (fire, blasts, debris, frost, lightning through water, rain), so it does what the world does. `tier` opens when the mana cap reaches that tier (mana.json tiers). `cost` is mana. `shape` point | line (a line spell is aimed with a stroke of the light pen, at most `maxLen` cells). `sight`: live = the target must be LIVE on the scope (in a sensor circle, not hidden by smoke, lit or daytime); sensor = anywhere inside a sensor circle, dark or not (a flare is how you see in the dark). `travel`: ticks from FIRE until it lands = base + perCell x distance from the HQ (the spell leaves the bunker and has to get there). `cooldown` ticks before the same cartridge can be fired again. Damage numbers are hit points; enemies are hit through the damage rule call point (js/sim/mana/harm.js). Spells and fire follow the physics and can hurt your own production and military buildings, never infrastructure (§0.7). `glow` multiplies how much Glow the spell leaves (mana.json glow).

list.name: Lightning
list.about: A bolt from the clouds. In water the charge runs through everything connected; on land it jumps from one creature to the next.

list.name: Shield bubble
list.about: A dome of hard light for 30 s. Creatures cannot come in, shots stop at its skin and fire dies at its edge.

list.name: Line of fire
list.about: Draw a line: a streak of flame races along it, lights everything that burns and scorches what does not.

list.name: Sensor flare
list.about: A magnesium star on a little parachute: lights a wide circle for 45 s so the scope can see in the dark.

list.name: Meteor
list.about: Pulls a stone down out of the sky. Leaves a crater ringed in rubble, burning blobs everywhere and the bunker shaking.

list.name: Frost snap
list.about: Freezes water solid, puts fires out and stiffens anything caught in it.

list.name: Call rain
list.about: A local downpour for 45 s: wets the ground, drowns fires, turns bare soil to mud.

list.name: Stone ridge
list.about: Raises a line of rock that nothing can walk through for a minute, then crumbles to rubble. Leaves gaps where it crosses roads.

list.name: Mend
list.about: Knits your own buildings, walls and squads back together in a circle, puts their fires out and greens the burnt ground.

combos._doc: First time each happens, High Command sends a commendation on the teletype (event `combo`). Detected in js/sim/mana/combos.js.

list.name: CHARGED WATER
list.text: Lightning through the water took several of them at once.

list.name: CHAIN LIGHTNING
list.text: The bolt jumped through a whole line of them.

list.name: STEAM BATH
list.text: A meteor into water. The whole valley is fogged.

list.name: HARD-LIGHT FIREBREAK
list.text: The shield held a fire front at its edge.

list.name: KINDLING
list.text: A line of fire through dry grass.

list.name: NIGHT STRIKE
list.text: Struck in the dark by flare light.

list.name: CHAIN REACTION
list.text: A blast set off a mana battery.
